scientific_intent.application_domain: RWKV sequence-model time-mixing primitive / depthwise causal temporal convolution
scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Per-channel causal convolution plus offset and derivatives with respect to channel weights and batched inputs
scientific_intent.numerical_method: Float32 shared-memory staged temporal sums, four temporal outputs per lane, BF8/BB2 grouping; independent Float64 direct convolution and symbolic derivatives
scientific_intent.community_use: Forward/backpropagation operator for sequence models; not a complete language model or training study
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Full forward/perbatch gradW/gradK at atol2e-5 rtol2e-5, exact inputs and guards; independent bilinear adjoint identity and host batchsum
limitations: Supplied upstream derivative, not full nonlinear loss/tanh/autograd pipeline
Original large32x768x768 workload and end-to-end allocations/batchreduce unmeasured
Only legal grouped B and 4-aligned T<=768 fixtures

shared_observed_usage_windows.scope: Consumed inference tokens during declared phase, including repeated/cached context and any coordination. Marker-turn alignment is approximate; not exclusive source translation or monetary billing. Cached input and reasoning are subsets, not extra totals. No historical recovery. Parent/shared workflow spans overlap subphases and must not be added to them.
shared_observed_usage_windows.counter_span_interpretation: Observed counter difference; alignment and interleaving prevent exclusive billed-cost claims. Zero/no-new-event spans cannot imply zero translation effort.
